guard: deprovisionAgent purges the retired lifecycle's durable membership rows for its exact memberChannels
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core exec tsx smoke/deprovision-agent-auth.smoke.ts
why: The deprovisionAgent helper deletes exact-keyed durable membership rows for the retiring lifecycle.
Removing the member deletion loop leaves the retired lifecycle's member rows in place.
The suite must catch this on the named cell asserting the retired lifecycle's named-channel rows are gone.

mutations.name: deprovisionAgent skips deleting member rows on the target channels
mutations.find: const mOutcome = await purgeKvKeyWithAccounting(jsm, membersKv, membersBucket(opts.space), mKeyStr);
mutations.replace: const mOutcome = "absent" as const; /* member row deletion skipped */
mutations.expectRed: MEMBERS: the retired lifecycle's named-channel rows are GONE
mutations.cell: MEMBERS: the retired lifecycle's named-channel rows are GONE
